card.title: 3.7cm FLAK 37
card.flavorText: The 3.7 cm Flak 18/36/37/43 was a series of anti-aircraft cannons produced by Germany and used by the Axis forces during WWII. The cannon was fully automatic and effective against aircraft flying at altitudes up to 4,200 m and was produced in both towed and self-propelled versions. A total of 20,243 weapons of these series were built, most of which were of the Flak 36 and Flak 37 variant design.
